item.title: Return of the Duck Cult: A Doors of Divergence ARG? | ARGNet: Alternate Reality Gaming Network
item.description: Doors of Divergence is a series of three escape rooms where your choices in the one room impacts your experience in the next. The NYC location closed in October 2023, but an ARG is teasing an eventual return.

item.title: I’m Obsessed with Emerald Echoes’ Narrative Hint System | ARGNet: Alternate Reality Gaming Network
item.description: Postcurious' narrative puzzle game Emerald Echoes features a narrative hint system, meaning even the answer-checking system tells a story. The Kickstarter campaign runs through August 14th.

item.title: KFC Launches Special Blend of 11 Secret Codes and Puzzles | ARGNet: Alternate Reality Gaming Network
item.description: KFC's newest commercial celebrates the Colonel's obsessions by challenging solvers to 11 puzzles hidden in the video, using clues on The11Secrets.com ...and now I'm obsessed.

item.title: It’s Been Here the Whole Time: The Boy Who Cried “Dropout ARG” | ARGNet: Alternate Reality Gaming Network
item.description: Game Changer's last episode of season 7 launched an ARG through Dropout's minigames that may just unlock the "real" finale. Although Dropout fans thought they found ARGs the last two seasons too...

item.title: Masquerade: NYC’s New Immersive Musical Launched With a Secret ARG | ARGNet: Alternate Reality Gaming Network
item.description: Masquerade just brought Phantom back to Broadway. But even before Previews, Andrew Lloyd Webber's new immersive musical teased the show with an expansive ARG that drew the Opera Ghost to our world.

item.title: Ministry of Lost Things Delivers a Box of Puns with a Side of Puzzles | ARGNet: Alternate Reality Gaming Network
item.description: PostCurious' newest project Ministry of Lost Things: Finders Keypers is crowdfunding on Kickstarter for a pun-laden puzzle game perfect for logic puzzle fans looking for some tactile fun.

item.title: Stephen Sondheim Loved Puzzles More Than You | ARGNet: Alternate Reality Gaming Network
item.description: Matching Minds with Sondheim is a book that explores the composer and lyricist's enduring passion for puzzles and games, and the lasting impact his works have left on the space.

item.title: The King in Yellow as Found Footage Minecraft ARG | ARGNet: Alternate Reality Gaming Network
item.description: Searching For A World That Doesn't Exist is a recent Minecraft ARG loosely based on the King in Yellow mythos, in which a YouTuber pieces together found footage from a Minecraft playthrough

item.title: The Immersive Side of Hawkins: From Scoops Ahoy to WSQK Radio | ARGNet: Alternate Reality Gaming Network
item.description: The final season of Stranger Things ended on January 1st, but WSQK Radio continued to broadcast online. The six week broadcast was one of many immersive extensions of the hit Netflix series.

item.title: Start Slacking Off with MrBeast’s Million Dollar Puzzle Hunt | ARGNet: Alternate Reality Gaming Network
item.description: Salesforce's newest Super Bowl commercial launched a Million Dollar Puzzle, in collaboration with MrBeast. The puzzles extend beyond the Big Game spot itself, promising to extend out into the real world.
